:::{#def-sensitivity}
#### Sensitivity

The **sensitivity** of a diagnostic test is the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability)
that the test is [positive](#def-positive-classification) ($\posclass$),
given that the person tested has the disease ($D$):

$$\text{sensitivity} \eqdef \Pr(\posclass \mid D)$$ {#eq-sensitivity}

Source: @wikipedia_sensitivity_and_specificity.
:::
